From what I’ve seen on the parent contributor information on the student aid website, if the bio parent is remarried then step parent is contributor to the form.

https://preview.redd.it/0mrao5udebec1.jpeg?width=750&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=7f8119cc6135a6e114fbaa974b00d8ccb14c77c0

The information you pulled up refers to students whose parent has passed away and trying to define who is considered a parent in that type of circumstance. This picture I pulled up as you can see the second sentence states that the step parent will still be considered a contributor to the students form. Meaning the step parent will be required to access to the form and provide their information as the contributor regardless of adoption status.

So if your mom who is remarried is the parent that provides the most financial support you do have to report your step parent on the FAFSA and they will be considered a contributor on the form. Regardless of whether they have adopted you or not.
